For CHEAP. I would keep an eye on Gap / Old Navy and frequent thrift stores. I got a Gap Fishtail Parka out of season for 80% off. (Reg. $140)

If you're looking for "reliable" rain gear.. sadly, you aren't going to get anything like that for cheap, unless its thrifted/used. Even the cotton canvas Gap parka has poor coverage and needs to be waxed for decent rain protection.

The other option is to go synthetic. Try a Patagonia Torrentshell, which again you can find cheap used or on sale depending on the season. This is probably a better bet for reliable rain protection.
